title: qa profile (qa.json at the repo root)
description: Credentials are never values here: a credential is the NAME of an environment variable.

seedNames.description: JSON file naming seeded records for $seed.* in the map (default qa/seed.json)

integrationBranch.description: The branch PRs merge into (e.g. staging/master): the default base of ready, verify and affected, before origin/HEAD, main and master

retryWaitMs.description: wait before the runner's one retry of a BLOCKED sandbox up (default 15000)

extra.description: offsets of the ports the app opens beside its own (a mock server at PORT+300): every sandbox reserves port + each offset, and no two sandboxes overlap

clock.description: Browser clock during capture: 'seed' (default) freezes it at the sandbox's seed start, 'off' leaves it real, an ISO time freezes it there

volatile.description: Regexes of text the seed cannot pin (a seed-time stamp); masked in both trees before the diff

checks.description: The seven page checks run on every capture (step 3)

touchBelow.description: A viewport narrower than this is touch: 48 px targets and the keyboard check

keyboardHeight.description: Viewport height while the on-screen keyboard is open

tour.description: The tour on each screen's last capture (step 3); a screen's own tour key merges over it

open.description: Extra selectors of controls to open

skip.description: Selectors of controls never to open

limits.description: Human limits per metric name: a number replaces the default, null drops it. Names: screen.readyMs, screen.bytes, screen.requests, screen.longTaskMs, screen.heapBytes, server.appMs, server.dbMs, server.queries; unknown names are ignored

questions.description: The project's own eyes-pass questions, asked of every changed or new screen after the six core ones

routes.description: The route sweep: the table of routes, the request headers per role, and the origin probes

enabled.description: false skips the sweep on every side (default true)

table.description: The route table, a path relative to the tree (default: the first that exists of qa/routes.table.json, .ts, .mjs)

base.description: The API base the sweep calls (default: the headers verb's baseUrl, else the sandbox's app URL)

origin.description: true adds the foreign and null Origin probes on writes (default false)

signIn.description: false when the sandbox answers every call as a signed-in user (a dev-user gate): the sweep plans no signed-out, no-right or other-id probe (default true)

headers.description: Request headers per role, anon included: { role: { Header-Name: ENV_NAME } }, each value read from the environment. Used for a role when the stack has no headers verb

mutants.description: The breakage checks: the mutant registry file, and the default limit of one suite run (a test expectation's run, a mutant's, a ready check's). A suite's own timeoutMs in qa/suites.* replaces it for that suite

file.description: The mutant registry (MUTANTS only; its old SUITES are read while the project has no qa/suites.*), a path relative to the tree (default: the first that exists of qa/mutants.json, .ts, .mjs)

timeoutMs.description: Per suite run, unless the suite gives its own (default 900000)

plan.description: qa plan check (rework U6): the checks on the planner's expectations before the run.

maxMatches.description: At most this many elements one screen expectation may match on one capture (default 20)

ready.description: qa ready (0.5.0). emptyText: the project's own empty-state phrases (regex sources, case-insensitive), added to the built-in ones the walk check looks for.

stubs.description: Rung 3 of the evidence ladder (design §6.1): a deterministic stand-in for what varies (a model's answer, a payment provider), as env switches the sandbox sets on every stack verb when the PR's charter names the stub (its `stubs:` line). The key is the stub id (a plain name). An env NAME that looks like a secret is refused: a stub sets a switch, never a credential.

for.description: What it stands in for, in a person's words ("the chat model's answer")

env.description: { "<ENV NAME>": "<non-secret switch value>" }, set on setup, up, seed, build, serve and down

affected.description: Affected runs (step 7). ui: file extensions that count as screens' own files for the unmapped rule.

agents.description: qa verify (rework U10, design §13 and §14): the headless Claude sessions it starts for each role. Defaults: mapper haiku 20 min, planner sonnet 30 min, security sonnet 20 min, eyes opus 30 min, judge sonnet 20 min.

mapper.description: the mapper's repair round after the prepare check (default haiku, 1200000 ms)

model.description: the model of this role's headless session: an alias (haiku, sonnet, opus) or a full model id

timeoutMs.description: how long one call of this role may take before it is killed and the round is handed over (at least 60000)

planner.description: the verifier's plan phase and its plan-check send-back (default sonnet, 1800000 ms)

model.description: the model of this role's headless session: an alias (haiku, sonnet, opus) or a full model id

timeoutMs.description: how long one call of this role may take before it is killed and the round is handed over (at least 60000)

security.description: the security review and its write-up (default sonnet, 1200000 ms)

model.description: the model of this role's headless session: an alias (haiku, sonnet, opus) or a full model id

timeoutMs.description: how long one call of this role may take before it is killed and the round is handed over (at least 60000)

model.description: the model of this role's headless session: an alias (haiku, sonnet, opus) or a full model id

timeoutMs.description: how long one call of this role may take before it is killed and the round is handed over (at least 60000)

judge.description: the verifier's judge phase and its report-check send-back (default sonnet, 1200000 ms)

model.description: the model of this role's headless session: an alias (haiku, sonnet, opus) or a full model id

timeoutMs.description: how long one call of this role may take before it is killed and the round is handed over (at least 60000)
